description: Check a saved connection against its provider right now (a read-only identity call) and record the result. Use it when a node fails with what looks like an authentication error: access that worked when it was saved may since have been revoked or narrowed. Returns the connection's metadata with its new status, never the secret. Some providers cannot be checked on their own, and neither can a connection under the owner's extra passkey protection; both answer `not_eligible`.

credentialId.description: The connection's id, from list_connections or check_setup.
